definition: Localized intensity maximum associated with a diffraction spot
notes: Review together with reflection and peak finding terminology.

definition: Diffraction spot or indexed reflection represented in overlays and metadata
notes: Keep consistent with beamline and crystallography usage.

definition: Detection workflow that identifies candidate diffraction peaks
notes: Must stay distinct from generic search wording.

definition: Overlay ring corresponding to a constant d-spacing on the detector
notes: Prefer terminology used by diffraction users in each language.

definition: Detector pixel position of the direct beam center
notes: Keep units in px.

definition: Sample-to-detector distance used for geometry and ring calculations
notes: Keep units in mm.

definition: Incident beam photon energy used for wavelength and ring calculations
notes: Keep units in eV.

definition: Detector pixel pitch used for geometry calculations
notes: Keep units in um.

definition: Beam wavelength used in diffraction geometry
notes: Keep Angstrom notation.

definition: Detector threshold or energy channel selection for multi-threshold data
notes: Should not sound like a generic UI channel selector.

definition: Scaling or reference correction applied before series reduction
notes: Keep distinct from standardization/calibration if those mean something else locally.

definition: Arithmetic average of pixel or frame values
notes: Statistical term.

definition: Middle value of an ordered numeric distribution
notes: Statistical term; review carefully in every locale.

definition: Arithmetic total of pixel or frame values
notes: Statistical term.

definition: Region of interest used for measurements and plots
notes: Keep acronym if that is the domain norm for the locale.

definition: Ring-shaped region of interest bounded by inner and outer radius
notes: Coordinate with ROI wording.

definition: Single detector image within a stack or live stream
notes: Keep distinct from generic picture or video frame when necessary.

definition: Ordered set of frames processed as one reduction job
notes: Should align with series operations UI.

definition: Per-pixel detector mask hiding invalid or excluded pixels
notes: Distinguish from overlay or selection mask if needed.

definition: Pixel whose intensity has reached the datatype or detector maximum
notes: Must stay distinct from defective pixel.

definition: Pixel known to be invalid because of detector defects
notes: Must stay distinct from saturated or gap pixels.
